description: Hydrostatic semi-implicit NHFLOW (A 534 1) on the three blocks of nhflow_3d_mb_open_faces_mpi2 with clamped edges on the blocks (B 522): a clamped discharge edge on the -i face of block 1 (zone 1, B 525 0.03 m3/s with a 0.2 s ramp) and a clamped level edge on the +i face of block 2 with a water level time series (zone 2, background 2 from background-2.dat, B 510 mode 2). The same solution as one block with the zones on its x edges, see Dropbox validation 01_block_edges.
covers: ioflow_amr_block::edges_nhflow (clamped discharge with B 525, clamped level with a time series background)
nhflow_momentum_SI::bc_method with the zones of the blocks (bc_zone_set::zone_block, lexer::amr_block)
